description: Source code for the XAIHandler class implementing a provider for OpenAI-compatible API interactions, including message creation, model retrieval, and error handling.

classes.name: XAIHandler
classes.description: A class that extends BaseProvider to handle interactions with the XAI API, including message streaming and prompt completion.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the XAIHandler with provided options, setting up the OpenAI client.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Retrieves the model configuration based on options and default settings.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Creates a message stream with the specified system prompt, messages, and metadata, handling streaming responses and errors.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt synchronously using the API and returns the generated text.
